reviewPassage:
LIBRARY LISTENING BOOTHS
Starting and finishing your booking

Your reserved minutes do not start until you press Ready inside the booth. This leaves time to plug in your headphones, but it is not an extra reservation. If you are more than five minutes late, the booth may be assigned to someone else.

The booth displays two signals. A flashing amber light outside tells other visitors that someone is using the booth. The digital display inside shows how many minutes remain. It does not make a sound in the final minute. If you need to finish a sentence, wait for a natural stopping point rather than rushing to the door. The touch panel will briefly say FINISHED before it returns to the welcome screen.

Please leave the headphones hanging beside the panel. If you borrowed an adapter, hand it to the desk staff on your way out.
reviewPassageZh:
圖書館聆聽亭
開始與結束你的預約

直到你按下亭內的「準備好了」，預約時間才開始計算。這讓你有時間插上耳機，但不會額外多一段預約時間。遲到超過五分鐘，聆聽亭可能會改分配給別人。

聆聽亭有兩種提示。外面閃爍的琥珀色燈表示有人在使用；裡面的數字顯示器則顯示還剩幾分鐘。它在最後一分鐘不會發出任何提示音。如果還需要講完一句話，等到自然的停頓點再結束，不用急著往門口走。觸控面板會短暫顯示「已結束」，然後回到歡迎畫面。

請把耳機掛在觸控面板旁。如果有借用轉接頭，離開時請交還給櫃檯人員。
